speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I need to understand what is causing your acute diarrhea. How long have you had these symptoms, and have you experienced any fever, blood in your stool, or severe abdominal pain?

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Antibiotic-Associated Diarrhea (likely *Clostridioides difficile* infection).

I suspect this is due to the levofloxacin you were taking for pneumonia. Have you noticed any recent changes in bowel habits before starting the antibiotics, and have you been exposed to anyone else with diarrhea recently?
